name: Mobile payment app launch
context: Your teams are building a mobile payment app scheduled to launch in 4 weeks at a national fintech event.
The CEO demands every promised feature must go live.
Yesterday, the government introduced new data compliance laws that could affect your app's payment flow and storage practices.

risks.d: Data compliance regulation may block app release.
Integration with payment gateway is unstable.
High workload is causing team burnout.
Several features are untested but are still in scope.
Stakeholders demand last-minute UI changes.

mits.d: Isolate unstable payment feature from MVP
Enforce code freeze on untested modules
Allow only minor UI tweaks with formal impact signoff
Hire external legal team to assess data compliance
Add automated test coverage for critical workflows (partial)
Conduct a dry-run deployment and rollback test
Introduce team wellness check-ins and reduce sprint WIP

name: GenAI resume screening pilot
context: Your product team is launching a GenAI-powered resume screening platform for a major recruiting firm.
It's expected to go live within 2 weeks in a pilot with real candidate data.
list: A news article questions the ethical fairness of your AI model.
The client asks for a “gender-neutrality” audit before go-live.
Your internal ethics team is unavailable due to a cybersecurity incident elsewhere.
The core AI model is producing inconsistent results for multilingual resumes.
The business insists on going live to meet a demo commitment with their investors.

risks.d: AI bias accusation damages brand reputation
Model fails to handle resumes in regional languages
Gender fairness audit fails or is incomplete
Cybersecurity incident drains internal audit resources
Business pushes go-live regardless of risk readiness

mits.d: Engage external firm for short-term cyber advisory & backup compliance resource
Conduct fairness checks using open-source gender de-biasing tool
Hold internal go/no-go meeting with legal + branding team
Hire external AI ethics consultant to conduct rapid audit
Add disclaimer for AI decisions in onboarding flow
Revert to earlier stable AI model trained only on English data
Temporarily disable multilingual support & flag it as known limitation in pilot

name: CRM migration after a merger
context: Your product and engineering team is migrating user data into a new unified CRM system as part of a company merger.
You have 6 weeks to complete the migration, and stakeholders from both organizations are demanding new features and dashboard redesigns during the same period.
Unfortunately, the user data is scattered, inconsistent, and managed differently across platforms.
Meanwhile, leadership wants a board-level demo before the next quarter.

risks.d: Data migration fails due to incompatible schemas
Your top engineers are pulled off the project by HR post-merger
Stakeholders insist on last-minute UI and analytics changes
Analytics module causes duplication and misreporting
Users experience downtime during CRM migration and start churning
Board insists on live demo before system is ready

mits.d: Secure written resource lock-in from HR
Use synthetic test data to validate migrated records across systems
Implement a stakeholder change freeze until migration is complete
Prepare a staged cutover with rollback plan and downtime alerts
Create a pre-recorded product walkthrough for board demo
Hire a data architect to create mapping & reconciliation plan
Isolate analytics module in sandbox environment

name: Retail checkout before peak weekend
context: Your engineering team is rolling out a new checkout and inventory system for a national retail chain, going live 3 weeks before the biggest sale weekend of the year.
Marketing has already announced the sale date publicly and the CEO will not move it.
A critical security patch was released for the payment library you depend on.
Your warehouse partner is migrating to a new logistics API in the same window, and support staff have not been trained on the new order flow.

risks.d: Checkout fails under peak sale traffic
Unpatched payment library exposes a known security vulnerability
Warehouse partner's new logistics API breaks order fulfilment
Untrained support staff cannot handle customer issues at peak
Inventory counts go out of sync and the store oversells stock
Announced launch date cannot be moved even if the system is not ready

mits.d: Run load and stress tests against peak traffic projections
Apply and regression-test the payment library security patch
Build a fallback integration to the warehouse partner's existing API
Run hands-on support training with a live order-flow simulation
Add real-time inventory reconciliation with oversell alerts
Prepare a feature-flagged rollout with instant rollback
Agree a phased launch scope with marketing in writing
Freeze all third-party integrations two weeks before the sale weekend
